observation.command:
cd /tmp; python3 - <<'EOF'
import zipfile, re
z=zipfile.ZipFile('logic.jar')
for n in z.namelist():
    if not n.endswith('.class'): continue
    d=z.read(n)
    if b'githubPackagesToken' in d:
        print("HIT", n)
        for x in re.findall(rb'[\x20-\x7e]{4,}', d):
            print("   ",x.decode())
EOF
